mapper.sql: SELECT account.code AS "accountCode", account_type.code AS "accountTypeCode", register_type.register_type_code AS "registerTypeCode", currency.currency_code AS "currencyCode", COALESCE(SUM(line.quantity), 0) AS "quantity" FROM account JOIN account_type ON account_type.account_type_id = account.account_type_id JOIN register ON register.account_id = account.account_id JOIN register_type ON register_type.register_type_id = register.register_type_id LEFT JOIN (journal_entry_line line JOIN journal_entry entry ON entry.journal_entry_id = line.journal_entry_id AND entry.posted >= #{postedFrom} AND entry.posted < #{postedBefore}) ON line.register_id = register.register_id LEFT JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = line.currency_id
GROUP BY account.code, account_type.code, register_type.register_type_code, currency.currency_code ORDER BY account.code, register_type.register_type_code, currency.currency_code
